title: P104 free helper endpoints: conditional κ .0030814243 (retime of #5551's word)
body:
## Summary

Complete conditional kappa **.0030814243** (+3.99e-5, +1.31% over #5551's .0030415312), tested at .0030814205, exact raw crossing in (.00308142433380, .00308142433381). Supporting word with free helper *starts* only: **.0030768801** (+3.54e-5).

Package: `research/p104-free-endpoint-retime/` (task card `scalar-to-moment`, recorded as `scope_status: changed`; the package retimes helper endpoint/stop frames of #5551's word rather than pursuing scalar A2 contractions).

## What changed

A retime of helper endpoints and a collapse of 170 stops on #5551's pinned word. It is **not** an unchanged circuit: the scalar program (21,686 events, registers, coefficients, order) is identical, but 168 helper start spans and 23 helper final spans differ, 607 frame labels are relabelled, and 3,624 -> 3,454 MOVEs. All 208 main registers keep identical initial and final spans; productive fields (12,814) and rank-mass surplus (760) are unchanged; paid calls 69,912 -> 66,852.

The retime was found by an exact-lattice CP-SAT solve (multi-worker, not byte-reproducible), so the package ships both words plus `retime.py`, a stdlib checker proving each is a legal retime of #5551's pinned word. `pricing*.py` are #5551's pricing with literal-only changes (`LITERAL-CHANGES.diff`); the PR5545 `local.py` is used unmodified.

## Conditional on

(a) the five framework assumptions retained by #5544/#5545/#5551; (b) the validity of #5551 (unreproduced at the time of writing); (c) free helper START frames and free helper FINAL frames. The verifier checks only nesting and rank = dimension gap for helpers; the canonical-start rule exists only in the #4610 verifier, and unmodified #5544 already has mid-frame helper starts and mixed finals. The supporting word needs only free starts. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. The selected record is not changed.

## Verification

- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-free-endpoint-retime --check-only`
- `verify.py --part headline` and `--part starts-only` (each about 6 minutes): retime legality, unmodified #5545 replay/columns/native, physical caller, both moment engines, all 54 strict + 4 functional outer checks, exact crossing intervals.
- An internal AI audit (separate read-only Claude agent) reproduced an earlier #5545-based version of this retime and rated maintainer intent for free helper frames as unresolved.

Also cherry-picks the one-line `wordram-ntt-kernel` VERIFY.json input fix needed for onboarding tests on current main.
